SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT user_id, source_message_id FROM sq_response_execution WHERE status NOT IN ('SUCCEEDED', 'PARTIAL', 'FAILED', 'CANCELLED') UNION SELECT user_id, origin_message_id AS source_message_id FROM sq_goal_task WHERE origin_message_id IS NOT NULL AND status NOT IN ('SUCCEEDED', 'PARTIAL', 'FAILED', 'CANCELLED') ) pending WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sq_final_delivery delivery WHERE delivery.user_id = pending.user_id AND delivery.source_message_id = pending.source_message_id )
